description: This file declares the LogFileHandle class used for managing file handles within the firebolt::rialto::logging namespace. It provides methods for singleton access, initialization with a file path, and querying the file descriptor and open state.

classes.name: LogFileHandle
classes.description: A singleton class managing a file handle, providing initialization and status methods.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LogFileHandle.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the log file handle with the specified file path.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the file handle is currently open.
